city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh u Beogradu je umerenog kvaliteta; osetljive grupe mogu osetiti blagi uticaj.
city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Posmatrač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Danas no longer leads with the election appeal: its newest headline puts armed police in front of ALTA banka in Novi Beograd [F8], while Studio B's newest is now the Vučić–Orbán meeting, not a sector reassurance [F9]. At Garaža "Pionirski park" the displayed free spaces went from 172 to 280 [F6], but Parking Servis gives no measurement time [F5], so I can't tell when that happened. Tanjug adds a weekend "Halloween avantura" at Beograd na vodi [F7].
